summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K to disclose a material fact: as of May 4, 2026, it placed dematerialized bearer bonds in the local market under a pre-registered line of credit. Series AA-5 bonds totaling 706,000 UF (approximately $27M at current UF value) were issued with a 2.50% average placement rate, maturing February 1, 2032. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. The filing contains no stake, premium, or deal terms; the registrant is solely the issuer of fixed-income securities. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are relevant. There is no risk-arb angle; this is a standard capital markets transaction.
